svg.title: The Ranger's Book: the first page
svg.desc: The front of the logbook, which is not a ledger at all: a notebook's Sites page in pencil, in a younger Marisol's hand, with ink columns ruled over it later. A party of five is written in at 20 to 24 with the check-out column empty, and its row 21 is the same sentence as Tam's. On the facing page, Tam's two notebook lines about it.
svg.text: the split boulder, slept in the crack
the hand that kept the book

g.text: Marisol turned to the front to show
me how a book is kept.
21 the split boulder, slept in the crack
Her row 21 and my row 21 are the
same sentence. Hers is older. Check.
